about: Shared test cases for the version comparison (roadmap V2.3). The game (scripts/version_compare.gd), tools/version_compare.py and the website's own code must give the same answer for every case here, so copy this file into the site's repository and run it there too. Change a rule only by changing this file first.
rules: A version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, three numbers without leading zeros (0 is fine, 03 is not), each at most 9 digits, optionally followed by - and a pre-release: dot separated identifiers made of 0-9 A-Z a-z. Build metadata (+abc) is not allowed. Nothing else is valid: no leading v, no spaces, no empty parts, no hyphen inside a pre-release.
MAJOR, MINOR and PATCH are compared as numbers, so 0.10.0 is newer than 0.9.0.
A version with a pre-release is older than the same numbers without one: 0.3.0-alpha is older than 0.3.0.

Two pre-releases are compared identifier by identifier from the left: two numbers as numbers (alpha.2 is older than alpha.10), a number is older than a text, two texts by their ASCII order (capitals before small letters). When all shared identifiers are equal, the one with more identifiers is newer (alpha is older than alpha.1).
Two valid versions give -1 (a is older than b), 0 (equal) or 1 (a is newer). If either one is not valid there is no answer: the game and the site treat it as 'unknown' and never as 'up to date'.
